subject: E-1211: database locked on Windows
body:
Good morning. My setup is SyncVault 4.2.7, Windows 11 23H2. Starting the
weekend, the moment I open the app a dialog reads 'E-1211: local database is
locked'.

Our team keeps the database file on a shared network drive. A colleague
said the drive dropped out for a minute this forenoon.

What I attempted so far: restarting the computer. No luck.

Thanks, Grace Okafor (Northbank Studio)
